categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in residential and commercial building construction, property sales and leasing, interior decoration design and construction, building materials and machinery trading, and industrial park development and management. It also operates supermarkets and parking lots, manufactures cement and construction materials, and provides urban planning and consulting services. The main revenue driver is the construction and sale of apartment and residential buildings.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes integrated project delivery (IPD) methods to enhance design and construction efficiency, emphasizing quality control, cost reduction, and timely project completion. It adopts green building designs and sustainable construction practices, including the use of recyclable materials and energy-efficient technologies. The company also focuses on innovative construction techniques to improve safety and reduce waste.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are individual homebuyers and corporate clients within the Greater Taipei area. The company targets end-users with rigid housing demand, including first-time homebuyers and self-occupiers. It also serves tenants for its commercial leasing properties, including office and retail spaces.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in the Greater Taipei metropolitan area, including Taipei City and New Taipei City, with projects in districts such as Xindian, Tamsui, Neihu, and Zhongshan. The company also has an investment subsidiary in the United States but focuses its main development activities domestically.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the real estate supply chain, focusing on land acquisition, property development, construction project management, and sales/leasing. It outsources construction work to subcontractors but controls project planning, design, and marketing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing product design with a focus on 'Good House/A.I. Building' smart home concepts, maintaining high construction quality, and controlling costs amid rising material and labor expenses. The company emphasizes sustainable development, ESG compliance, and urban renewal participation. It invests in R&D to optimize construction techniques and integrate green building standards aligned with Taiwan's net-zero carbon goals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the sale of residential and commercial properties, rental income from leased buildings, and subsidiary engineering services. The company also earns income from property management and related service fees. It does not rely on subscription or licensing models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with other established real estate developers in the Greater Taipei area, including well-known brands recognized for quality and brand loyalty. It positions itself as a premium developer emphasizing location advantage, product quality, and customer service. Market share in Taipei is modest but focused on high-value projects.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, the company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$2.1 billion, with a net profit of around NT$298 million, reflecting a decline from the previous year due to fewer recognized property deliveries. Total assets are about NT$32.3 billion, with equity near NT$14.6 billion. The company shows stable but slightly declining profitability amid a cooling real estate market.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes human-centric design, high construction quality, and sustainable living environments. It differentiates through innovative smart home concepts, green building certifications, and comprehensive customer service from pre-sale to post-sale. Its focus on prime locations and urban renewal projects further enhances its competitive edge.
